statements: Regulation of the health professions is a reserved matter under Section G2 of Part II of Schedule 5 to the Scotland Act 1998, and so is generally outside the legislative competence of the Scottish Parliament.
Under section 29(2)(b) of the Scotland Act 1998 a provision of an Act of the Scottish Parliament is outside competence so far as it relates to reserved matters.
"The health professions" is defined for Section G2 by a closed, exhaustive list of nine regulating enactments, so a profession not regulated by one of those Acts is not within the reservation.

Section G2 contains express exceptions carving out the subject-matter of section 21 of the National Health Service (Scotland) Act 1978, and of section 25 of that Act so far as it relates to vocational training and disciplinary proceedings.

Whether a provision relates to a reserved matter is determined by the purpose test in section 29(3), judged by reference to the provision's purpose and having regard among other things to its effect in all the circumstances.
